catalog.title: Who uses this junction?
catalog.question: Which way do vehicles turn, and how many people cross?
limits: A spawn request is not a counted movement.
Only configured camera entry/exit pairs can establish a turn.
Buses use the existing through-only route permission; no bicycle episode is enabled.

catalog.title: A queue grows, then clears
catalog.question: Where does the approach queue end, and is crossing access blocked?
limits: Extent is the visible queue estimate, not the full queue beyond the camera.
The queue head is near the south crossing, not inside the junction box; no blocked-junction duration is claimed.
Follower requests do not guarantee a camera count; clearance depends on signals and actual observations.

readiness.basis: loaded actor and route capability; native navigation is checked before placement

catalog.title: People wait, cross, and clear
catalog.question: How long do people wait, and is someone still on the crossing?
limits: Wait is time observed in a configured waiting area, not intent inferred from appearance.
The demo does not identify disability, age, or protected traits.
The camera does not change real signal timing.

readiness.basis: loaded actor and route capability; native navigation is checked before placement

catalog.title: A stopped car blocks curb access
catalog.question: How long is this curbside lane occupied, and when is it free?
limits: This is a curbside-lane stop, not a validated parking manoeuvre.
ROI occupancy alone does not establish an illegal stop or a loading purpose.
No ticket, licence-plate recognition, or enforcement decision is produced.

readiness.basis: loaded actor and route capability; native navigation is checked before placement

catalog.title: Keep the crossing clear
catalog.question: Has a vehicle stopped across the pedestrian crossing?
measurements: Vehicle in the configured crossing zone
Exact analysed frame for operator review
limits: This is an observed obstruction; it is not a crash or near-miss classifier.
The curated northbound approach family leaves into the visible junction; other approaches are not selected.
No collision, emergency response, or synthetic AI verdict is scripted.
Visibility, projection and camera-derived clearance still need live validation.
